description: Update a Stay's organisational data: address, check-in/out policy, pets/children/parking, cancellation policy, accommodation type, tourism/land-registration numbers, 'Why Choose Us' reasons, and more. Only fields supplied are changed. IMPORTANT: countryId, petsAllowedId, childrenAllowedId, parkingId, cxPolicyId, and stayTypeId are lookup IDs, NOT plain text or booleans — call getCountryOptions / getAdditionalInformationOptions / getCancellationPolicyOptions / getStayTypeOptions first to find the correct ID to send. Requires an MCP agent token scoped to the owning account.

childrenAllowedId.description: An optionId from getAdditionalInformationOptions(filterName='Children Allowed') — NOT a boolean.

countryId.description: A country ID from getCountryOptions — NOT a country name.

fullPayment.description: Whether guests must pay in full up front (vs. pay on arrival). Only settable if the Stay's country allows it — check fullPaymentAllowedByCountry from getMyStayOrganisationalData first; writing true when the country doesn't allow it will be rejected.

parkingId.description: An optionId from getAdditionalInformationOptions(filterName='Parking') — NOT a boolean.

petsAllowedId.description: An optionId from getAdditionalInformationOptions(filterName='Pets Allowed') — NOT a boolean.

reason1.description: First 'Why Choose Us' reason shown to guests

registeredBusiness.description: Whether the Stay is officially registered for tourism/lodging

name: updateStayOrganisationalData
